papers.title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
papers.translated_title: 可靠的树木识别从稀缺标注中用于森林资源清查扩展
papers.author: Luiz Fernando Souza Luz
papers.summary: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.
papers.translated_summary: 来自无人机影像的单木树冠（ITC）物种级清单受限于标注成本：在热带森林中，许多物种仅有少量经野外验证的树冠作为代表。我们提出一个可靠的树木招募框架，通过在RGB无人机正射影像上迭代自训练一个多任务DeepLabV3网络来扩大小规模标注清单，该网络将语义分割与树冠距离回归头相结合。在每次迭代中，候选树冠只有在通过基于类别概率和距离图的置信度过滤器以及基于树冠面积和实心度的形态学过滤器后，才能进入训练清单，每个物种最多新增五个树冠，从而使招募样本与参考清单保持一致。我们在两个巴西站点评估该框架：阿克里州的一处亚马逊雨林（17个物种，355个标注树冠，4厘米地面采样距离）和马腊尼昂州塞拉多的一处森林站点（4个物种，51个标注树冠，1.8厘米地面采样距离）。经过20次迭代，保留树冠的数量在阿克里州从约500个增长到960个，在马腊尼昂州从约700个增长到超过3100个，同时树冠级F1超过单任务和多任务DeepLabV3基线（53.5%对50.0%和45.2%；92.2%对79.7%和83.6%）。该框架提供了一条低成本途径，可利用消费级无人机和有限的野外工作来扩展物种清单。

papers.title: ScaleBench: An Extensible and Reproducible Experimental Platform for Kubernetes Autoscaling Research
papers.translated_title: ScaleBench：一个可扩展且可复现的Kubernetes自动扩缩容研究实验平台
papers.author: Ze Wang
papers.summary: Autoscaling enables cloud-native applications to meet their SLOs by dynamically adjusting computational resources at runtime. Recent research has explored a broad range of advanced autoscaling approaches, including rule-based, optimisation-based, and machine learning-based techniques, to address the limitations of traditional resource management strategies in cloud-native environments. Despite significant advances, a considerable gap remains between academic innovations and their practical adoption in real-world environments. For instance, Kubernetes deployments commonly rely on the reactive, CPU-based Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, limiting the adoption of more advanced autoscaling approaches. Recent studies have investigated challenges such as autoscaler configuration and reproducible performance evaluation; however, the practical deployment, integration complexity, and operational overhead of research-based autoscalers in Kubernetes environments have received limited attention. To address this gap, we present ScaleBench, a native Kubernetes experimental platform to enable extensible and reproducible evaluation of autoscaling solutions. Unlike existing approaches, ScaleBench integrates autoscalers as native Kubernetes components, allowing researchers to assess not only scaling performance but also deployment characteristics and integration requirements within realistic cloud-native environments. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ScaleBench by evaluating multiple autoscaling approaches through a case study. The results highlight its capability to support systematic, repeatable, and practical assessment of Kubernetes autoscaling approaches.
papers.translated_summary: 自动扩缩容通过在运行时动态调整计算资源，使云原生应用能够满足其SLO。近期研究探索了广泛的先进自动扩缩容方法，包括基于规则、基于优化和基于机器学习的技术，以解决传统资源管理策略在云原生环境中的局限性。尽管取得了显著进展，学术创新与其在真实环境中的实际采用之间仍存在相当大的差距。例如，Kubernetes部署通常依赖反应式的、基于CPU的Horizontal Pod Autoscaler，限制了更先进自动扩缩容方法的采用。近期研究调查了自动扩缩容配置和可复现性能评估等挑战；然而，基于研究的自动扩缩容方案在Kubernetes环境中的实际部署、集成复杂性和运维开销受到的关注有限。为弥补这一差距，我们提出ScaleBench，一个原生Kubernetes实验平台，用于实现可扩展且可复现的自动扩缩容解决方案评估。与现有方法不同，ScaleBench将自动扩缩容方案集成为原生Kubernetes组件，使研究人员不仅能够评估扩缩容性能，还能在真实的云原生环境中评估部署特性和集成需求。我们通过案例研究评估多种自动扩缩容方法，展示了ScaleBench的有效性。结果凸显了其支持对Kubernetes自动扩缩容方法进行系统、可重复且实用评估的能力。

papers.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
papers.translated_title: RSIBench-Infra：智能体能否在生产规模下优化自身的训练与推理基础设施？
papers.author: Hanlin Wu
papers.summary: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve production-scale training and inference performance, but identifying effective optimization strategies and consistently translating local improvements into end-to-end gains remain challenging.
papers.translated_summary: 提升训练与推理基础设施的效率是递归自我改进的一个实际组成部分。现有的面向智能体驱动优化的基准主要集中于内核等单个软件层，因而无法明确智能体能否在生产负载下带来端到端性能提升。我们提出 RSIBench-Infra，这是一个包含 20 个训练与推理任务的基准，涵盖多样化的模型家族与模态，部署规模最高达 32 个加速器，运行于 NVIDIA GPU 与昇腾 NPU 之上。智能体从源自官方配方的可运行基线出发，可在引擎、内核与指令层面修改软件栈。OCI 镜像层提交协议可捕获这些改动以实现可复现部署，而独立评估则在任务特定的质量约束下测量端到端性能。在所有任务结果中，66.2% 超过了经校验的 1.10 倍加速。这些结果表明，当前智能体能够提升生产规模的训练与推理性能，但识别有效的优化策略并将局部改进持续转化为端到端收益仍然具有挑战性。

papers.title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.translated_title: 循环神经网络中的时间秩
papers.author: Leo Dobson
papers.summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. On controlled sequence tasks, the resulting model exhibits rapid learning despite remaining strictly within a standard RNN formulation. Our results demonstrate that RNN performance is governed by the evolution and preservation of temporal rank, and suggest that mitigating gradient pathologies alone is insufficient without explicitly maintaining temporal capacity.
papers.translated_summary: 循环神经网络（RNN）是时序建模的自然框架，然而因其顺序、不可并行化的计算以及难以捕捉长程依赖（通常归因于梯度消失与爆炸）而常被忽视。我们识别出一个独特且尚未被充分探索的局限性：由秩约束的隐藏状态动力学所引发的信息瓶颈，它限制了随时间可被保留的独立输入方向的数量，这体现在输入到状态映射的秩上。我们证明该约束独立于梯度稳定性而限制时序容量。为解决这一问题，我们引入结构化高维状态动力学，其保持时序可分性并防止输入到状态雅可比矩阵随时间饱和。在受控序列任务上，所得模型尽管严格保持在标准RNN公式之内，却表现出快速学习。我们的结果表明，RNN性能受时序秩的演化与保持所支配，并表明仅缓解梯度病态而不显式维持时序容量是不够的。

papers.title: Enhancing Active Learning Performance with Initial Data Selection Based on Foundation Models
papers.translated_title: 基于基础模型的初始数据选择提升主动学习性能
papers.author: Mohammad Mirzaee
papers.summary: In active object detection, selecting the initial labeled pool is essential, especially in complex datasets with expensive labeling and low resource budget. This study presents an active learning framework designed to optimize the initial training cycle of active learning for the object detection task. Our approach diverges from traditional methods by utilizing feature-based clustering from the YOLO-World model and refining images based on objectness scores rather than relying on uncertainty sampling in the initial cycle. This approach focuses on finding samples with various features and emphasizes training in areas where the foundation model is most confident. Doing so helps the model better understand different types of objects. For subsequent cycles, we employ a consistency-based sampling technique to maintain the robustness of the training process. To evaluate our method, we use two complex datasets called Aquarium and NWPU VHR-10, which are well known for their diverse object sizes and challenging conditions. In the NWPU dataset, our method increases mAP50 by an average of 6.6% in image-based evaluation. Moreover, the image refinement method shows an improvement of approximately 11% in object-based evaluation. The results show improvements in model performance and labeling time, demonstrating the advantages of using foundation models in early cycles of active learning. An implementation of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/Mhrshd-fllh/ALBoost-FM
papers.translated_summary: 在主动目标检测中，选择初始标注池至关重要，尤其是在标注成本高昂且资源预算有限的复杂数据集中。本研究提出了一个主动学习框架，旨在优化目标检测任务中主动学习初始训练周期。我们的方法不同于传统方法，而是利用YOLO-World模型中基于特征的聚类，并基于目标性分数对图像进行精炼，而不是在初始周期依赖不确定性采样。该方法侧重于寻找具有多样特征的样本，并强调在基础模型最有信心的区域进行训练。这样做有助于模型更好地理解不同类型的对象。对于后续周期，我们采用基于一致性的采样技术来保持训练过程的鲁棒性。为了评估我们的方法，我们使用了两个复杂数据集，分别为Aquarium和NWPU VHR-10，它们以对象尺寸多样和条件复杂而闻名。在NWPU数据集上，我们的方法在基于图像的评估中将mAP50平均提高了6.6%。此外，图像精炼方法在基于对象的评估中显示出约11%的提升。结果表明模型性能和标注时间均有所改善，展示了在主动学习早期周期中使用基础模型的优势。算法实现可在https://github.com/Mhrshd-fllh/ALBoost-FM获取。

papers.title: What Majority Labels Hide: Annotator Disagreement and Model Errors in Multi-Dialect Arabic Sexism Detection
papers.translated_title: 多数标签所掩盖的：多方言阿拉伯语性别歧视检测中的标注者分歧与模型错误
papers.author: Alaa Bazaid
papers.summary: Judgements of sexism are subjective and may vary across communities, yet sexism detection datasets usually reduce annotator judgements to a single majority label, obscuring disagreement and how models behave on contested cases. We introduce MuDAS, a dataset of YouTube comments in Saudi, Egyptian and Moroccan Arabic, each labelled by three native speakers of its dialect, with the individual annotations preserved. We use it to evaluate Arabic encoders fine-tuned with hard-label, soft-label and perspectivist objectives, GPT-5.6 Terra, and four Arabic-centric large language models. Model errors are more frequent on comments with annotator disagreement. Despite relatively close Macro-F1 scores, GPT-5.6 Terra and the fine-tuned encoders exhibit contrasting error patterns: GPT-5.6 Terra, even with the annotators' definition of sexism, over-classifies gender-related content such as religious advice on modesty, whereas the encoders miss implicit and prescriptive sexism. The Arabic-centric models also over-predict sexism and remain below the encoders. Disagreement-aware learning preserves Macro-F1, but soft labels improve alignment with annotators on contested comments at the expense of unanimous ones, and neither paradigm reliably identifies contested comments. Lower performance on Egyptian Arabic, clearest for the large language models, is not fully explained by the examined measures of test-set composition and dialectness. Majority-label scores can therefore hide contrasting error patterns that matter for content moderation.
papers.translated_summary: 性别歧视的判断具有主观性，且可能因社群而异，然而性别歧视检测数据集通常将标注者的判断简化为单一的多数标签，从而掩盖了分歧以及模型在有争议案例上的表现。我们推出MuDAS，这是一个包含沙特、埃及和摩洛哥阿拉伯语YouTube评论的数据集，每条评论由其所属方言的三名母语者标注，并保留了个体标注。我们用它来评估以硬标签、软标签和视角主义目标微调的阿拉伯语编码器、GPT-5.6 Terra以及四个以阿拉伯语为中心的大语言模型。模型在标注者存在分歧的评论上错误更为频繁。尽管Macro-F1分数相对接近，GPT-5.6 Terra与微调编码器表现出截然不同的错误模式：GPT-5.6 Terra即便在给定标注者对性别歧视的定义下，仍过度将性别相关内容（如关于端庄的宗教建议）归类为性别歧视，而编码器则漏掉了隐性和规定性的性别歧视。以阿拉伯语为中心的模型同样过度预测性别歧视，且表现低于编码器。分歧感知学习保持了Macro-F1，但软标签以牺牲一致评论为代价改善了对有争议评论与标注者的一致性，且两种范式都无法可靠识别有争议的评论。埃及阿拉伯语上的较低表现（在大语言模型中最为明显）无法完全由所考察的测试集构成和方言性度量来解释。因此，多数标签分数可能掩盖对内容审核至关重要的截然不同的错误模式。

papers.title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
papers.translated_title: 如何将注意力神经网络转化为可解释的硬逻辑谓词电路：忒修斯之船替换下的真值表谓词提取与状态机合并
papers.author: Yuchen Li
papers.summary: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same tweets, and that of BERT-base reaches 70.0 $\pm$ 0.5% with order selection and 63.7 $\pm$ 1.2% with rule selection against 77.8%. The circuit needs no multiplier and no weight traffic, and its exported hardware description reproduces it bit for bit. By a synthesis-based estimate it classifies one tweet in about 1-2 $μ$s (DistilGPT2) and 3-5 $μ$s (BERT) on an FPGA card and in 5-9 $μ$s on a palm-sized board whose module draws 7.5-15 W, two to three orders of magnitude faster than the network on a GPU at batch 1 (measured, 0.9-2.6 ms for DistilGPT2 including an optimised CUDA-graph baseline), at a cost of 8.5 (DistilGPT2) and 8.6 (BERT) points of gold accuracy for the synthesised seed-0 circuits.
papers.translated_summary: 我们将一个训练好的注意力网络作为一个整体（包括注意力机制在内）转换为一个硬逻辑谓词电路，由该电路代替原网络运行。电路的每个单元都是关于词元的0/1谓词，谓词之间的每个映射都是最小化后的真值表。短真值表（例如查询码与键码的乘积）被精确最小化，而宽泛的特征到特征转换则通过容噪最小化转化为蕴含规则。各模块按照“忒修斯之船”的方式，从输出端开始逐一替换，每次替换后剩余的软部分会重新适应已冻结的电路。注意力选择有两种形式：对整数分数进行逐行比较（顺序选择）和学习得到的规则（规则选择）。两者都仅在普通训练集上拟合，且仅使用教师分类正确的样本，从而使电路在教师正确之处模仿教师。在TweetEval-emotion上，DistilGPT2的完整电路在三个随机种子下，采用顺序选择达到66.5 ± 1.3%的测试金标准准确率，采用规则选择达到57.4 ± 2.5%，而教师为74.7%，在同一批推文上拟合的词片袋模型为64.0%；BERT-base的完整电路采用顺序选择达到70.0 ± 0.5%，采用规则选择达到63.7 ± 1.2%，而教师为77.8%。该电路不需要乘法器，也不需要权重传输，其导出的硬件描述能够逐位复现该电路。根据基于综合的估计，在FPGA卡上分类一条推文约需1-2 μs（DistilGPT2）和3-5 μs（BERT），在模块功耗为7.5-15 W的掌上型板上约需5-9 μs，比批大小为1时GPU上的网络快两到三个数量级（实测，DistilGPT2包括优化的CUDA图基线为0.9-2.6 ms），代价是综合后的种子0电路的金标准准确率分别下降8.5（DistilGPT2）和8.6（BERT）个百分点。

papers.title: Where Should a Diffusion Transformer Meet Its Teacher?
papers.translated_title: 扩散Transformer应在何处与其教师相遇？
papers.author: Zhuoqi Hu
papers.summary: Representation Alignment (REPA) significantly accelerates Diffusion Transformer training by guiding intermediate student features with a pretrained visual teacher, yet existing methods typically attach supervision to a single fixed layer. As student representations evolve, however, we find that the most effective layer for alignment varies across training stages. To track this evolving layer suitability online without costly search, we measure gradient compatibility between the flow-matching and alignment objectives, and propose AdaREPA, an online routing framework that adaptively selects the supervision layer as training progresses. AdaREPA uses a softmax distribution over smoothed layer compatibility scores to sample a layer for alignment at each training step. This probabilistic routing adapts teacher supervision to the student's changing learning needs, with minimal training overhead and no additional inference cost. On ImageNet-256, AdaREPA accelerates convergence and improves generation quality across model sizes, while revealing how the most suitable layers for supervision shift over training.
papers.translated_summary: 表示对齐（REPA）通过使用预训练的视觉教师模型引导学生的中间特征，显著加速了扩散Transformer的训练，然而现有方法通常将监督附加到单个固定层上。然而，随着学生表示不断演化，我们发现最适合对齐的层会随训练阶段而变化。为了在不进行昂贵搜索的情况下在线追踪这种不断变化的层适用性，我们测量了流匹配目标与对齐目标之间的梯度兼容性，并提出AdaREPA，一种在线路由框架，可随着训练进展自适应地选择监督层。AdaREPA在平滑后的层兼容性分数上使用softmax分布，以在每个训练步骤中采样一个用于对齐的层。这种概率路由使教师监督适应学生不断变化的学习需求，训练开销极小，且不增加额外推理成本。在ImageNet-256上，AdaREPA加速了收敛，并在不同模型规模上提升了生成质量，同时揭示了最适合监督的层如何随训练而变化。

papers.title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
papers.translated_title: MoE-Context：只向模型展示其所需内容
papers.author: Vedant Navale
papers.summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.
papers.translated_summary: AI智能体在每一步都会读取其全部历史记录。人类并非如此运作：我们保留当下所需的信息，将其余部分作为粗略笔记留存以备回忆。MoE-Context将这一机制应用于语言模型。上下文被分割为多个块。在每一步之前，一次快速的“是/否”判断决定该步骤需要哪些块；其余块保留为一行笔记，可随时调回，且不删除任何内容。在我们构建的版本中，一个模型做出此判断后作答，基于单一键值缓存运行，其中隐藏块被掩蔽而非移除。在搭载Qwen3-1.7B的笔记本电脑上，使用合成查找任务，仅显示所需块将准确率从120次中的93次提升至119次，且被掩蔽的块与已删除的块同样隐蔽。模型自身的挑选是薄弱环节。将监督线性探针写入备用输出行，将其准确率从120次中的80次提升至110次，但简单关键词搜索在此任务上表现完美，且该探针无法迁移至第二项任务。我们公开报告这些结果，以及块切换所支持的两种低成本使用模式：撤销失败尝试和无需新上下文运行子智能体。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
papers.translated_title: LLM辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化：融合专家知识与数值数据
papers.author: Dongjun Han
papers.summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.
papers.translated_summary: 多保真度贝叶斯优化（MFBO）通过将低成本的低保真度（LF）模型与少量准确的高保真度（HF）评估相结合，并顺序选择待评估的设计，从而降低工程设计成本。然而，当高保真度数据稀缺时，仅凭数值数据难以学习低保真度与高保真度之间的差异，尤其是当低保真度模型中省略的物理因素使其差异依赖于设计时。然而，即使没有足够的数据，领域专家通常也知道低保真度模型省略了哪些物理因素，以及在何种条件下其影响会增大。现有多保真度（MF）模型无法直接利用这类定性知识，但大语言模型（LLM）可以对其进行解释并据此比较设计。所提出的LLM辅助MFBO在传统MF模型的基础上增加了一个知识基：根据专家对省略物理因素的描述，LLM判断两个设计中哪一个需要更大的带符号残差修正，并通过成对高斯过程将这些判断转换为该知识基。高保真度数据用于校准其贡献和符号，因此知识不会被盲目信任。在一个锂离子电池设计问题上，所提出的方法将传统MFBO的曲线下遗憾面积减少了61%。通过一项独立变化两者的对照研究显示，决定搜索是否加速的是知识质量而非LLM的选择。知识层面的消融进一步量化了每条知识陈述的贡献。这些结果表明，LLM解释的专家知识可以作为MFBO中的一种信息源来补充数值数据。
